newsitem.title: USA: Dow holds sharp gains, bulls firmly in charge.
newsitem.headline: Dow holds sharp gains, bulls firmly in charge.

text.p: U.S. blue chips remained in record territory and tech stocks widened their gains in afternoon activity Friday, as market bulls extended their session-long romp after this morning's employment report.

The Dow industrials gained 130 points to 7435, just off their session peak but still well above the all-time high closing level of 7383.41. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 14 points to 1404, about six points off its record closing level.
"The techs snapping back certainly is a positive," said Hildegard Zagorski, market analyst at Prudential Securities.
"That certainly was a sector that had cast a cloud over the market," she said.
Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by two-to-one on the NYSE and roughly four-to-three on Nasdaq.
The rally also took hold in the bond market, where the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury leapt 1-7/32 to yield 6.78 percent, a yield last seen at the close on February 28.
